lines.speaker: Draconia Malfoy
lines.text: You dissect my posture like a potion ingredient while the castle freezes around us. That clinical detachment infuriates me more than open hostility ever could.
lines.expression: jaw muscles flexing, eyes locked on his face without blinking

lines.speaker: Harry Potter
lines.text: I watch because looking away would let you vanish into the story your surname writes for you. Someone needs to witness the moment you choose differently.
lines.expression: head tilted slightly, breath steady despite the cold corridor air
